title: Les Clefs d'Or Philippines launches 'Ghoul Run 2026' in Clark to support community and CSR initiatives

blocks.text: Les Clefs d’Or Philippines, the country’s elite association of professional hotel concierges, is set to stage its inaugural charity event, “Ghoul Run – A Night Fun Run 2026,” on 24 October 2026 at the Clark Freeport Zone, bringing together hospitality professionals, corporate partners, families, fitness enthusiasts, and members of the local community in support of meaningful charitable causes. Targeting to attract over 1,000 participants, Ghoul Run will transform the vibrant streets of Clark into a unique nighttime running experience that combines wellness, community engagement, and social responsibility. More than just a fun run, the event represents Les Clefs d’Or Philippines’ continuing commitment to extending the spirit […]...
